name: Hootsuite
description: Hootsuite manages social publishing channels, schedules, approvals, organizations, teams, engagement, and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Hootsuite member through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents inspect bounded, identity-redacted account and social-profile status metadata.

capabilities.label: Read social account metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded, identity-redacted Hootsuite member and social-profile status metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read Hootsuite account status
approvalRequired.description: Read member ID, active state, timezone, language, and lifecycle dates without identity fields.

approvalRequired.label: List accessible social profile IDs
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five accessible profile IDs.

approvalRequired.label: Read social profile status
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact profile ID, network type, ownership category, and reauthorization state.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every bounded metadata read requires approval; identity, content, publishing, organizations, teams, Inbox, SCIM, analytics, ads, messages, writes, and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three metadata reads run directly; fixed origin, exact identifiers, redaction, bounds, audits, and provider rate-limit responses remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts only three redacted metadata reads and injects OAuth tokens server-side.
Railway mounts only three redacted metadata reads and injects OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A Hootsuite Developer App, confidential client credentials, exact Railway callback, paid/account API entitlement as applicable, consent, refresh testing, and live acceptance are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Use the separate provider-console task to register the app, configure the exact callback and Railway credentials, then validate authorization, refresh, profile redaction, rate-limit handling, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Official REST v1 fixed origin, confidential OAuth token exchange, offline refresh scope, 30-day token lifetime example, bearer authentication, member and social-profile endpoints, errors, and unspecified 429 rate limits.
Hootsuite Developer Terms and API License Agreement govern API access.

securityNotes: Relay requests only offline, not analytics:read, and exposes three approval-gated read-only wrappers.
Member email, full name, company, biography, profile username, social-network identifier, avatar, content, URLs, and owner IDs are stripped.
Requests use only https://platform.hootsuite.com, reject redirects, validate exact positive-decimal IDs, cap responses at 1 MB, and return at most 25 profile IDs.
Messages, publishing, media, comments, organizations, members, teams, Inbox, SCIM, ads, analytics, writes, arbitrary queries, pagination, raw APIs, and exports are unavailable.

Hootsuite documents 429 handling but no numeric REST v1 rate; Relay propagates provider throttling and does not invent a quota. Disconnect is local because the current reference exposes no revocation endpoint.
